analysis.title: Carrier Global Corp. (CARR): 3Q26 First Take: 3Q miss (ex IEEPA), FY26 guide lowered
key_insights: CARR reported 3Q26 adj. EPS of $0.87 against GS $0.73 and FactSet consensus $0.76, but GS calls the quarter a miss excluding about $130mn of IEEPA refunds booked in segment EBIT.
Segment EBIT was +11% vs GS and +8% vs FactSet consensus as reported. Excluding the IEEPA refunds it was -2% vs GS and -4% vs consensus.
Total segment margin was 18.1%, 90bps above expectations as reported. Excluding the $130mn of IEEPA refunds it missed by 120bps.
3Q organic growth was +15% (GS +14.2%). By segment: Americas +25% (GS +27.7%), Europe +12% (GS +3.5%), Asia Pacific MEA +3% (GS +2.0%), Transportation -3% (GS -2.5%).
Americas residential organic growth was above +30% against GS +22%, while total Americas organic growth of +25% was slightly below GS +28%.

Total organic orders were about +35% (vs about +40% last quarter). Americas orders were about +60%, with residential about +45%, light commercial about +15% and commercial HVAC (ex NORESCO and Riello) about +90%.

Europe orders were about +30%, led by residential about +25% and light commercial about +50%. Asia Pacific MEA orders were about +5% (China about +5%, the rest about flat). Transportation orders were about +5%, with global truck and trailer about +5% and container about flat.
Record backlog of more than $8.5bn (+60% y/y) positions CARR for accelerating growth going into next year, per GS.

CARR lowered its 2026 EPS outlook to $2.85-$2.90 from about $2.90, against GS $2.85 and consensus $2.89. The guide assumes organic sales growth of about +10% (prior about +MSD-HSD, GS +9.2%) and FCF of about $2.0bn.
Implied 4Q EPS of $0.55-$0.60 is below consensus of $0.69 and implies 4Q Climate Solutions Americas margins of about 13% (GS 18.5%).
GS views the lower CSA margin expectation as prudent but expects the shares to underperform on the day given the core EBIT miss excluding IEEPA and the lowered guide.
GS stays Neutral with a 12-month price target of $61 (14.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA). The stock closed at $56.27 on 28 Oct 2026, implying 8.4% upside.

market_movers.rationale: Neutral and $61 target (14.0x Q5-Q8 EBITDA, 8.4% upside to $56.27) are unchanged by this first take. GS expects the shares to underperform today on the ex-IEEPA core EBIT miss and the lowered FY26 EPS guide.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 adj. EPS reported $0.87 vs GS estimate $0.73 and FactSet consensus $0.76 (3Q25 adj. EPS $0.67). Reported 10/29/2026.
3Q26 total revenue reported $6,263mn vs GS estimate $6,207mn and FactSet consensus $6,069mn (3Q25 $5,579mn). Reported 10/29/2026.
3Q26 total segment income reported $1,133mn (18.1% margin) vs GS estimate $1,022mn (16.5%) and FactSet consensus $1,046mn (17.2%). The reported figure includes about $130mn of IEEPA refunds.
3Q26 reported segment EBIT was +11% vs GS and +8% vs consensus. Excluding IEEPA refunds it was -2% vs GS and -4% vs consensus.
3Q26 Climate Solutions Americas revenue reported $3,354mn vs GS estimate $3,409mn and consensus $3,253mn. Segment margin reported 22.2% vs GS 20.0% and consensus 21.8%.
3Q26 Climate Solutions Europe revenue reported $1,335mn vs GS estimate $1,226mn and consensus $1,240mn. Segment margin reported 12.6% vs GS 10.0% and consensus 10.3%.
3Q26 Climate Solutions APAC and MEA revenue reported $848mn vs GS estimate $846mn. Segment margin reported 12.1% vs GS 12.1% and consensus 10.9%.
3Q26 Transportation revenue reported $726mn vs GS estimate $726mn and consensus $747mn. Segment margin reported 16.1% vs GS 16.2% and consensus 16.1%.
3Q26 tax rate reported 23.5% vs GS estimate 24.0% (3Q25 17.2%). Diluted shares reported 821.8mn vs GS estimate 829.9mn.
FY26 EPS guidance (company, guided 10/29/2026) lowered to $2.85-$2.90 from about $2.90 prior. GS estimate $2.85 and consensus $2.89 were the pre-guide comparison points.
4Q26 implied EPS from the guide is $0.55-$0.60 vs consensus estimate of $0.69. The GS estimate table lists 4Q26E EPS of $0.69 and 1Q27E of $0.55, set before this print.
GS annual EPS estimates: $2.59 for 2025 reported, $2.85 for 2026E, $3.20 for 2027E and $3.60 for 2028E.
risk_factors: Upside risks named by GS: stronger data center growth and better incremental margins.
Downside risks named by GS: inefficient capacity ramp, price/cost and mix pressure, and weaker end markets.
The implied 4Q Climate Solutions Americas margin of about 13% (GS 18.5%) points to margin pressure in the segment that drives growth.

tension_points.bull_case: Orders grew about +35% and record backlog of more than $8.5bn (+60% y/y) positions CARR for accelerating growth next year. Reported segment EBIT beat GS by 11% and consensus by 8%, with Americas residential organic growth above +30%.
tension_points.bear_case: Excluding about $130mn of IEEPA refunds, segment EBIT missed GS by 2% and consensus by 4%. FY26 EPS guidance was lowered to $2.85-$2.90, and implied 4Q EPS of $0.55-$0.60 sits below consensus of $0.69.
tension_points.what_invalidates: 4Q results are the checkable markers: the guide implies 4Q CSA margins of about 13% (GS 18.5%) and EPS of $0.55-$0.60 (consensus $0.69).
